title: Creating a Landing Page with Froala Tables and Pre-Made Elements
text:
## Creating a Landing Page with Froala Tables and Pre-Made Elements
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000043444
Follow the instructions below to learn how to create a landing page that looks like this:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819944/original/g92CQJfvPv_l3yX115Sc0L1FYOuJM8CL_g.png?1782143109 | alt: ]
1. Create a new static page. Click on this article for more information >> How to Create a New Static Page
2. Add a single row using the table option in the Froala Editor . Add background color and text as desired. In this example, we have used different font sizes of 22 and 16, respectively; also some words are bold:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819258/original/Le7mdX6RGftY8NPfsqQEcZDp9OrptPkM2A.png?1782142500 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819500/original/uNAJPVLXvbUdzSly2jVHfjinb6D5v2bEZw.png?1782142715 | alt: ]
3. Drag and drop the pre-made element "Text with Image Left" into the static page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819552/original/wWL9RV0gZS31XV8wuJnUeNXCDSUlHdeZ_w.png?1782142751 | alt: ]
4. Add the image and text as needed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819729/original/asEuHFw2YEnSCGm4sJK3EryJtOZM6Fmg7w.png?1782142976 | alt: ]
5. Edit the button text and link:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819767/original/jFsiWctrjxSEAGgUrnGCMlkVwupvJrtnMA.png?1782143019 | alt: ]
6. Save the changes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180819843/original/T8cl0pBSqWjvM2izHgx3zVWJoBDzB-OOeg.png?1782143058 | alt: ]
You can also create this page using our integrated AI solutions. See: 1. BD Butler 2. Quick Create Wizard - Create Web Page
